articles.summary: FREEHOLD, NJ, Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - UMH Properties, Inc. (NYSE: UMH) (TASE: UMH), a real estate investment trust (REIT) specializing in the ownership and operation of manufactured home communities, today announced that the Company will attend the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development's (HUD) annual Innovative Housing Showcase for the 6th consecutive year. The event kicks off with the Showcase Opening Ceremony on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, on the National Mall in Washington, D.C. and runs through Thursday, September 24, 2026. Samuel A. Landy, President and Chief Executive Officer, commented, “At this year’s Innovative Housing Showcase, UMH is proud to present two ground-breaking manufactured homes in partnership with Champion Homes and Cavco Industries. Making its debut on the National Mall is the first-ever HUD-code two-story manufactured home built by Champion Homes. This three-bedroom, two-bath home showcases the evolution of modern manufactured housing
articles.title: UMH PROPERTIES, INC. WILL ATTEND AND SHOWCASE TWO HOMES AT THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT’S ANNUAL INNOVATIVE HOUSING SHOWCASE
